Package it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.service

Class LowLoadManager

java.lang.Object
it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.service.LowLoadManager
@Service public class LowLoadManager extends Object
Service for managing and executing background tasks when the CPU load is low. It utilizes a thread-safe queue to hold tasks and periodically checks the CPU load before processing them to ensure main application performance is not impacted.

      public void addTask(Task.TaskType type, String recipeId, String chefId)

      type - the specific type of task to be executed
      recipeId - the unique identifier of the target recipe
      chefId - the unique identifier of the associated chef

    • addTask

      public void addTask(Task.TaskType type, InfoToDeleteDTO infoToDelete)
      Enqueues a background task associated with a list of recipe IDs to delete and the corresponding chefs. This is used for the foodie's profile deletion, in order to update chefs' popularity counters.
      Parameters:
      type - the specific type of task to be executed
      infoToDelete - a InfoToDeleteDTO containing the list of recipe IDs and a map associating each chef with their affected recipes

    • addTask

      Parameters:

    • addTask

      public void addTask(Task.TaskType type, GraphRecipeDTO recipe)
      Enqueues a background task associated with a specific recipe. This is used to add the specified recipe to neo4j when the admin approves a chef's recipe
      Parameters:
      type - the specific type of task to be executed
      recipe - a GraphRecipeDTO containing all the information required to add a new recipe on the graph DB

    • taskHandler

      @Scheduled(fixedDelay=10000L) public void taskHandler()
      Scheduled method executed every 10 seconds to process the background task queue. Tasks are executed only if the system CPU load is below 30%. To keep the application running smoothly, a maximum of 10 tasks are executed at a time. The rest are kept in the queue for the next run.

    • decrementSavesCounters

      public void decrementSavesCounters(TaskToDo task)
      Executed when the Task.TaskType is "SET_COUNTERS_FOODIE_DELETE". This method updates the popularity counters of the affected chefs according to the foodie's profile deletion.
      Parameters:
      task - a TaskToDo containing the list of recipes saved by the foodie and a map associating each chef with their corresponding list of saved recipes

    • decrementChefCounters

      public void decrementChefCounters(TaskToDo task)
      Executed when the Task.TaskType is "SET_COUNTERS_REMOVE_FAVOURITE". This method updates the popularity counters of the affected chef when a foodie removes a recipe from its favorites. In addition, updates the recipe's total saves in the recipe collection.
      Parameters:
      task - a TaskToDo containing the id of the target recipe and the id of the corresponding chef

      Parameters:
